# Illustrative transcript for s02 (whole-file edit format).
#
# LLM output is non-deterministic, so this shows the SHAPE of a run, not a
# byte-exact reproduction. Reproduce locally with:
#
#   cd agents/s02-wholefile-format
#   export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
#   go run . -v main.go util.go "move the parser into util.go"

# ---- what the model receives (system prompt, abridged) ----
You are a coding assistant that edits whole files.
To change a file, output its path on its own line, then the ENTIRE new contents
of that file inside a single fenced code block. You may edit MULTIPLE files ...

# ---- what the model replies with (the whole-file format) ----
I moved the parser into util.go and called it from main.go.

main.go
```go
package main

func main() { parse() }
```

util.go
```go
package main

func parse() {}
```

# ---- stderr, with -v ----
[s02] provider=anthropic model=claude-sonnet-4-6 files=[main.go util.go]
[s02] stop_reason=end_turn in=412 out=96 tokens

# ---- stdout ----
Applied edit to main.go (32 bytes)
Applied edit to util.go (33 bytes)

# Notes:
# - TWO files were rewritten from ONE reply; s01 could only do one.
# - The filename on the line above each fence is how the parser knows the path.
# - If a reply contains a bare ``` with no filename and you have >1 file in
#   chat, you'll see: "no filename provided before ``` in reply" and nothing is
#   written.
